verdict.rationale: Numeral's evidence centers on tax calculation, transaction/refund recording, nexus monitoring, filing/remittance, and VAT ID validation — there is no documentation of the product generating or shaping actual invoices with required VAT fields, registration numbers, or locale-specific invoice formatting rules. Integrations are described as calculating tax 'at checkout or invoice time' but nothing shows Numeral producing or populating compliant invoice documents themselves.
